details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement issue pipeline (`ai-clarify.yml`, plan, implement workflows and their prompts)
B. Review & Autofix (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_autofix_step_*.sh` helpers)
C. Orchestrator (`orchestrate*.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py`)
D. AI memory subsystem (`scripts/ai_memory.py`, `scripts/memory_helpers.sh`, memory maintenance)
E. Other: name the file, workflow or script in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What is the concrete problem, and what is "better"?
Choices:
A. A bug or failure: give the observed behaviour, the expected behaviour and a run ID or log excerpt if you have one (RECOMMENDED)
B. Performance or cost: give the metric to improve (runtime, tokens, GitHub API calls, OpenRouter spend) and a target
C. Reliability or flakiness: give the failing step and how often it fails
D. Docs or developer experience: give the doc or command that is unclear and what it should say or do
Q3: How do we know the work is done?
Choices:
A. A specific test, check or metric passes or reaches a stated threshold (say which) (RECOMMENDED)
B. A described behaviour change can be observed in a workflow run
C. A documentation or README change only, with no change in behaviour
